thesis: 금융여건은 '금리 긴축·신용 안정'의 혼합 상태다. 9월 FOMC가 정책금리를 3.75~4.00%로 25bp 인상했고 10년 실질금리는 9월 16일 2.68%까지 올라 성장주 duration에 역풍이다. 반면 미국 회사채 OAS는 0.78%, BBB OAS는 0.96%로 신용 스트레스 징후가 약하다. 신규 매수 속도는 약간 보수적으로 조정하되 현금창출력이 강한 NVDA의 기업가설 자체를 거시로 변경하지 않는다.

evidence.claim: The FOMC raised the federal funds target range by 25bp to 3.75%-4.00% on September 16, 2026 and said inflation remained elevated.
The September SEP median projected 2026 PCE inflation at 3.7% and the year-end federal funds rate at 4.1%, versus a 3.8% rate projection in June, indicating a higher-for-longer policy path.
The 10-year Treasury inflation-indexed real yield was 2.68% on September 16, up from 2.44% at the end of August.
ICE BofA US Corporate OAS was 0.78% and BBB OAS was 0.96% on September 16, 2026, indicating no broad corporate-credit stress.

counterevidence: Tight credit spreads can reverse abruptly and may understate tail risk after a long risk-on period.
Real yields are high enough that long-duration equity multiples remain vulnerable even without recession.
Strong capital investment and productivity can support earnings and offset some duration pressure.
Macro variables should not be used to override company-level moat, FCF or valuation evidence.
unknowns: How long the September 2026 inflation shock keeps the Fed above neutral
Whether elevated real yields persist once inflation normalizes
Whether AI-related equity issuance/capital formation creates a meaningful supply overhang
falsifiers: Investment-grade and BBB credit spreads widen sharply for several weeks
10-year real yields rise materially above current levels while earnings expectations stop rising
System liquidity or funding-market stress emerges despite currently tight spreads

key_kpis.name: 10Y real yield
key_kpis.threshold: Sustained move below ~2.3% would ease duration pressure

key_kpis.name: US corporate OAS
key_kpis.threshold: Remain near benign levels; sharp widening would reduce risk budget

key_kpis.name: Fed policy path
key_kpis.threshold: Evidence that inflation permits a lower policy path
